answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, revoked by a single upheld challenge, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the inlet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the thread of the next round.
